name: Acusol op 301
description: Acusol OP 301 (CAS 475673-75-7 ), also known as OP 301, is an alkali-swellable acrylic polymer emulsion designed for rheology modification and stabilization in aqueous formulations. It thickens and suspends at elevated pH, giving formulators precise control over viscosity and flow behavior across a range of end products. In personal care, it builds viscosity in shampoos and body washes. The polymer is ideal for conditioning systems where clarity and skin compatibility are priorities. Coatings formulators use it to control sag resistance and improve pigment suspension in waterborne paints. It is highly effective in architectural and industrial paints. In adhesives and sealants, it contributes to open-time management and application rheology in water-based systems for industrial use. Water treatment applications rely on its dispersing function to stabilize suspensions. This prevents particle settling in treatment chemical formulations, ensuring consistent performance in various environments. Acusol OP 301 is supplied as an aqueous polymer emulsion, typically in liquid form suitable for direct incorporation. It is available in technical grade for manufacturing needs. The product meets the performance requirements of industrial and personal care manufacturing.
